info.name: Banned Cards - Medusa Store API
info.description: Storefront-facing API coverage for the Banned Cards Medusa 2.21 backend. Run folders in order. Scryfall imports and image synchronization are CLI jobs.

item.name: 00 - Setup and health
item.description: Run first. Discovers the publishable key and CLP region.

item.name: 01 - Catalogue and discovery
item.description: Read-only endpoints. List requests capture IDs for detail requests.

item.name: 02 - Customer account
item.description: Registration, login, cookie session, profile, and address endpoints.

item.name: 03 - Cart and checkout
item.description: Run sequentially with a sellable variant. Shipping and payment require configured providers.

exec: const d=pm.response.json(); const x=d.order||(d.type==='order'?d:null); if(x&&x.id) pm.environment.set('order_id',x.id);

item.name: 05 - Returns and transfers (manual)
item.description: Requires a fulfilled order, return shipping option, or transfer token.
